name: Hokuto Corporation
summary: Hokuto Corporation engages in the research, development, production, and sale of mushrooms in Japan and internationally. The company offers various mushrooms, including Eryngii, king and marble oyster, Maitake, Bunashimeji, Bunapi, Shimofuri Hiratake, and Donko Shiitake. It also molds and sells plastic and synthetic resin products; produces and sells agricultural production materials and machines; and produces, processes, and sells agriculture products. In addition, it provides processed and health food products. The company was formerly known as Hokuto Industry Corporation and changed its name to Hokuto Corporation in October 2003.
